inputs.text: Listen, this brick kiln situation in Uttar Pradesh is no random government foul-up or honest delay. Three months after the mandate for environmental clearances, they're still claiming they can't establish any clear process, leaving the industry stuck in confusion and limbo. That's the official cover. What this really is is coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions who gain from keeping the small operators trapped and reliant on their rigged setup. These kiln owners already have approvals from the State Pollution Control Board for water and air standards, yet they're now being forced into extra clearances that are made deliberately murky to open the door for middlemen interference and control. It's not incompetence—it's the mechanism they use to enforce compliance while protecting their insiders. Legal experts pushing for court decisions to be followed are just propping up the whole thing, framing it as neutral rules when it's really about narrative control and deliberately weakening the industry under the environmental excuse. The entire delay is set up to serve those concealed interests, not to fix anything for the environment or the operators.
